hidden_states.description: deterministic synthetic BF16 hidden states sampled from N(0, 1)

router.routing: FP32 softmax over all router logits, followed by top-10 selection; selected routed weights are not renormalized

reference.description: FP32 routed-weighted sum of top-10 original BF16 expert outputs; each expert rounds the gated intermediate activation to BF16

quantization.description: Q2_K through Q8_K slots use llama.cpp quantize_row_qx_K_ref followed by dequantize_row_qx_K. If present, one-bit slots use llama.cpp IQ1_M via ggml_quantize_chunk followed by dequantize_row_iq1_m. One selected expert and one matrix are processed at a time.
quantization.iq1_m_importance: per-input weights derived from the measured activation: hidden_state^2 for gate/up and quantized-path intermediate^2 for down
